channel.title: Business Insider Africa - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Africa (africa.businessinsider.com)

item.title: DR Congo signs AI-powered mineral mapping deal with US firm Atlas Park
item.description: The Democratic Republic of the Congo has secured a new five-year partnership with US investment firm Atlas Park to bring AI-driven geological research to its mining sector, a move aimed at modernising how the country maps and manages its mineral resources.

item.title: Uganda’s gold exports jump to $6.4 billion in 2025, but net trade gain stands at $200million
item.description: Uganda’s gold exports have surged from $1.26 billion in 2019 to $6.4 billion in 2025, marking a more than fivefold increase in just six years and making gold the country’s largest export commodity.

item.title: Top 5 African countries with the fastest internet speed, according to latest ranking
item.description: Africa’s internet scene is buzzing like never before. According to the Speedtest Global Index, Morocco is leading the pack in Africa, claiming the top spot for mobile internet speed at an impressive 123.87 Mbps.

item.title: Top 10 universities in North Africa, according to latest ranking (2026)
item.description: North Africa’s higher education landscape is showing steady depth and diversity in the latest Times Higher Education World University Rankings 2026, with institutions from both Morocco and Egypt making strong impressions on the regional and global stage.

item.title: China expands Africa space ties with new satellite ground station in Namibia
item.description: China has handed over a newly built satellite ground station to Namibia near the capital, Windhoek, marking another expansion of Beijing’s overseas space cooperation programme.

item.title: France’s Safran to open a €280 million landing gear plant in Morocco to support Airbus A320 production
item.description: Safran Landing Systems has signed an agreement with Morocco to establish a €280 million ($332 million) landing gear manufacturing plant near Casablanca.

item.title: After U.S. extends AGOA, China finally agrees zero-tariff access for 53 African nations
item.description: China will implement zero-tariff treatment for imports from 53 African countries with which it maintains diplomatic relations from May 1, 2026, state media reported on Saturday, in a move that broadens Beijing’s preferential trade regime across the continent.

item.title: Mali renews Canadian mining giant's license for 10 more years after long-standing dispute
item.description: Mali’s government has approved a draft decree extending Barrick Mining’s Loulo gold mining permit by another 10 years, the country’s military leadership said in a statement on Friday.

item.title: Nigeria tries to catch up with Egypt and Algeria with 46 new fighter jets and helicopters
item.description: Nigeria’s Air Force said on Friday it is accelerating the acquisition of more than 46 advanced fighter jets, attack helicopters and unmanned aerial vehicles, reaffirming procurement plans first announced in July 2025 as Africa’s major military powers modernise their fleets.

item.title: African countries caught between UAE and Saudi Arabia as gulf rift spills into trade, gold and ports
item.description: African economies across the Horn of Africa and the Red Sea corridor are navigating rising commercial uncertainty as rivalry between the United Arab Emirates and Saudi Arabia shifts from Middle East security tensions into trade, ports and mineral exports.
